name: Miguel Santos
household: Lives with partner and a cat; shares cooking duties
psychographics: Prioritizes family time and reducing waste; believes a home-cooked meal is the best way to save money and stay healthy.
current_solutions: Uses Didi Food for occasional late-night cravings, but relies heavily on a shared Google Sheet with his partner to track pantry staples and avoid buying duplicates. Shops at local markets (Mercado) for fresh produce.
frustration: Ordered groceries via the Didi Food app at 7:30pm last Thursday; the delivery ETA kept pushing from 8pm to 9:15pm, and the driver cancelled without notification, leaving him with no dinner and having to spend 450 pesos on a convenience store ramen cup.
decision_style: Researches price per kilo across three different supermarkets before committing; buys in bulk only if the unit price is at least 20% cheaper than the corner store.
voice: Rambling and detail-oriented. Uses lots of parenthetical phrases and switches between Spanish and English mid-sentence when talking about food origins. Frequently says 'you know?' at the end of thoughts.
